hints.content: The arrow points to all values less than $-7$.
So, the inequality represents everything **less than $-7$.**

question.content:
**Choose the inequality that represents the following graph.**


[[☃ image 1]]

[[☃ radio 1]]

options.alt: A number line from negative 9 to 1 with evenly spaced tick marks in increments of 1. An open point is plotted at negative 7. A line running to the left starts at negative 7 and continues.

choices.clue:
The graph of $x>-9$ actually looks like this:

![A number line from negative 9 to 1 with evenly spaced tick marks in increments of 1. An open point is plotted at negative 9. A line running to the right starts at negative 9 and continues.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/ab6bb9d6fc9b4e790e821605b08d225e08628cfb)

The graph of $x<-8$ actually looks like this:

![A number line from negative 9 to 1 with evenly spaced tick marks in increments of 1. An open point is plotted at negative 8. A line running to the left starts at negative 8 and continues.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/ea4ddce6be9280c9c1aa889c19681ea131775611)

The graph of $x > -7$ actually looks like this:

![A number line from negative 9 to 1 with evenly spaced tick marks in increments of 1. An open point is plotted at negative 7. A line running to the right starts at negative 7 and continues.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/61aa3cd55aa44569f644516baea7fd6af3c1e958)
